All features from rounds 1-3 implemented according to the frozen acceptance contract.

test.summary: Test suite executed: 10 passed, 1 failed (exit code 1). Failure: test "invalid IDs and unknown tasks preserve persisted bytes" at line 191 - ID "1e0" should be rejected but is incorrectly accepted. The validateId function in lib/planner.mjs uses Number(str) which parses scientific notation "1e0" as 1, but IDs must be in canonical integer format (digits only). Fix: add regex check /^[1-9][0-9]*$/ before Number conversion to reject non-canonical formats like "1e0", "1.5", "1x" while accepting "1", "42", etc.

implementation.summary: Fixed validateId function in lib/planner.mjs to reject non-canonical integer formats. Added regex check /^[1-9][0-9]*$/ before Number conversion to ensure only canonical integer strings (digits only, no leading zeros) are accepted. This fix rejects "1e0", "1.5", "1x" while accepting "1", "42", etc. All functionality from rounds 1-3 (project add/list/report, task add/list/depend/ready/complete, dependency validation, readiness, completion) remains intact. The implementation now fully satisfies the frozen acceptance contract.
